sql: SELECT t.id AS ticket_id,t.sku,t.size,t.qty AS requested_qty,t.status,i.qty AS stock_on_hand,(t.qty-i.qty) AS shortfall,inv.id AS invoice_id,inv.amount,inv.due_date,inv.status AS invoice_status,CASE WHEN inv.status='paid' THEN 0 WHEN inv.due_date < (SELECT date_today FROM desk LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue,CASE WHEN inv.status='paid' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS shipping_blocked FROM tickets t JOIN inventory i ON i.sku=t.sku AND i.size=t.size LEFT JOIN invoices inv ON inv.id=t.invoice_id WHERE t.id=101;
